evidence_claims.claim: High input impedance and source impedance form a loaded measurement divider
evidence_claims.limitations: Resistive Thevenin approximation, not a general capacitive coupling model.

evidence_claims.claim: The 80V/2M source gives 66.67 V at 10M input and 3.81 V at 100k input
evidence_claims.limitations: Idealized values, arithmetic checked; not a real safe-voltage assertion.

evidence_claims.claim: Capacitive coupling can produce apparent ghost voltage on high impedance inputs
evidence_claims.limitations: No universal available-current claim from display alone.

evidence_claims.claim: Low impedance mode changes loading, not necessarily proof that no hazardous energy exists
evidence_claims.limitations: Field measurement selection and qualification remain site dependent.

evidence_claims.claim: Short transients may stress meter insulation without stable display indication
evidence_claims.limitations: Full IEC transient test clauses not verified in this review.

evidence_claims.claim: Measurement category combines application environment and working voltage rating
evidence_claims.limitations: No particular measurement location/category adjudicated; full text not reviewed.

evidence_claims.claim: IEC 61010-2-030:2023 scope covers equipment with measuring circuits connected externally
evidence_claims.limitations: Scope verified only, not normative test details.

evidence_claims.claim: Test leads, probes and selected terminals form part of instrument protection system
evidence_claims.limitations: Technical specifications and application-specific inspection needed.

evidence_claims.claim: Current jack/shunt path differs from voltage jack and wrong configuration can cause a fault
evidence_claims.limitations: No live measurement procedure or product wiring instructions.

evidence_claims.claim: Noncontact voltage indication alone is not comprehensive proof of absence

supports.location: guide on voltage detector types and selection

evidence_claims.limitations: Specific instruments have distinct sensing modes and performance.

evidence_claims.claim: True RMS meters remain subject to crest factor, bandwidth and range limits
evidence_claims.limitations: A True RMS label does not characterize all transients.

evidence_claims.claim: IEC 61557-1:2019 plus amendment 2024 sets general scope for testing protective measures
evidence_claims.limitations: Not a general instrument CAT rating and clauses/installation tests not reviewed.

evidence_claims.claim: NIST frames uncertainty as part of meaningful reported measurements
evidence_claims.limitations: No numerical uncertainty estimates for the hypothetical instrument.

evidence_claims.claim: OSHA verification rule covers U.S. workplaces and induced or backfed voltage
evidence_claims.limitations: Does not on its own determine homeowner permissions outside covered workplaces.
